rule.order: job-14 runs first; job-15 follows a job-14 pass and job-16 a job-14 fail; a void or intermediate job-14 ends the series
rule.readings: job-14 pass, job-15 fail: the failure follows the single-computation payload class; job-14 pass, job-15 pass: no single-path failure in this block, the payload class is not isolated; job-14 fail, job-16 fail then pass: the first 10000-sample entry of a job fails whatever its wrapper; job-14 fail, job-16 pass twice: one entry fails as a single computation does, two entries hold; job-14 fail, job-16 fail twice: 10000-sample entries fail without D2's leading 1500-sample entry; any other pattern, a void entry (other mesh, or a result whose results_list length differs from payload_entries) or an intermediate entry: no attribution
rule.series: single computation versus iterator payload on Q1's mesh (strategy.md section 7 item 13)
rule.statistic: tvd_cone_from_ideal per entry: total variation of the one-click histogram inside source 20's noise-bounded light cone from the served mesh's ideal propagation (scripts/qd_belenos_cone.py)
